en_title: Wolfenstein 3 Confirmed to Be in Development at MachineGames
cn_title: MachineGames确认正在开发《德军总部3》
opus_summary: 在西雅图举行的XBOX粉丝活动上，MachineGames和id Software确认《德军总部3》正在开发，由MachineGames再次负责。XBOX首席执行官Asha Sharma表示游戏已正式制作，开发团队还确认Brian Bloom和Debra Wilson将回归出演。

paragraphs.en: As part of the Xbox's 25th anniversary celebration at Xbox Fanfest in Seattle today, developer MachineGames and franchise creators id Software confirmed what had long been rumored : that Wolfenstein 3 is in development.
paragraphs.cn: 今天，作为西雅图XBOX Fanfest上XBOX 25周年庆祝活动的一部分，开发商MachineGames和该系列的创作者id Software证实了一个流传已久的传闻：《德军总部3》正在开发中。

paragraphs.en: MachineGames will once again be developing it. Wolfenstein 2: The New Colossus was released to rave reviews in 2017, but MachineGames then put the series on hold to develop 2024's absolutely stellar Indiana Jones and the Great Circle.
paragraphs.cn: MachineGames将再次负责开发。《德军总部2：新巨像》于2017年发售，获得了如潮好评，但MachineGames随后暂停了该系列的开发，转而制作2024年推出的、极为出色的《夺宝奇兵：古老之圈》。

paragraphs.en: But now, Wolfenstein is back on the front burner at the Swedish studio. "Wolfenstein 3 is officially in production at Machine Games," Xbox CEO Asha Sharma confirmed on X. "One of gaming’s most important franchises, and a team that has done remarkable work bringing it forward. Looking forward to sharing more."
paragraphs.cn: 但现在，《德军总部》重新成为这家瑞典工作室的首要项目。XBOX首席执行官Asha Sharma在X上证实：「《德军总部3》已在Machine Games正式投入制作。这是游戏界最重要的系列之一，而这个团队在推动系列发展方面做出了非凡的工作。期待分享更多消息。」

paragraphs.en: Wolfenstein 3 is officially in production at @MachineGames. One of gaming's most important franchises, and a team that has done remarkable work bringing it forward. Looking forward to sharing more. https://t.co/YyX8LrbTvh
paragraphs.cn: 《德军总部3》已在@MachineGames正式投入制作。这是游戏界最重要的系列之一，而这个团队在推动系列发展方面做出了非凡的工作。期待分享更多消息。https://t.co/YyX8LrbTvh

paragraphs.en: id Software and MachineGames added on to Sharma's post, which shows a page of the Wolfenstein 3 script, saying simply , "His reputation precedes him," referring to the action described on the script page. "Wolfenstein 3 is in production." The developers also confirmed that actors Brian Bloom (as B.J. Blazkowicz) and Debra Wilson (as Grace Walker) will return via a photo of the pair in the developer's motion-capture studio.
paragraphs.cn: Sharma的帖子展示了《德军总部3》剧本的一页，id Software和MachineGames在帖子后补充了一句简短的话：「他早已声名在外」，指的是这一页剧本中描述的动作。「《德军总部3》正在制作中。」开发者还通过一张两人在开发商动作捕捉工作室的照片，确认演员Brian Bloom（饰演B.J. Blazkowicz）和Debra Wilson（饰演Grace Walker）将回归。

paragraphs.en: Wolfenstein 3 shouldn't come as much of a surprise. Last year, in an interview with Noclip , MachineGames studio head Jerk Gustafsson said the team had "always seen [BJ's story] as a trilogy," adding: "That journey for BJ, even during those first weeks at [id Software], when we mapped out New Order — we still had the plan for at least [BJ], what would happen in the second one and what would happen in the third one.
paragraphs.cn: 《德军总部3》的出现应该不会太令人意外。去年，在接受Noclip采访时，MachineGames工作室负责人Jerk Gustafsson表示，团队「一直将[BJ的故事]视为一部三部曲」，并补充道：「BJ的这段旅程，甚至早在[我们加入id Software]的最初几个星期，当我们规划《德军总部：新秩序》时——我们就已经有了计划，至少是针对[BJ]的计划：第二部会发生什么，第三部又会发生什么。

paragraphs.en: "I think that's important to say, because⁠ — at least, I hope ⁠— we're not done with Wolfenstein yet. We have a story to tell."
paragraphs.cn: 「我认为这一点很重要，因为——至少我希望——我们还没有做完《德军总部》。我们还有一个故事要讲。」

paragraphs.en: That's not all that Wolfenstein fans have to look forward to, as the pioneering first-person shooter series is also being developed into a TV series at Amazon. Xbox's official 25th anniversary is this Sunday, November 15, while id Software celebrates its 35th anniversary this year.
paragraphs.cn: 《德军总部》粉丝可以期待的不止这些，这个开创性的第一人称射击游戏系列也正在由Amazon开发成电视剧。XBOX的正式25周年纪念日是本周日，即11月15日，而id Software今年迎来35周年。

paragraphs.en: Ryan McCaffrey is IGN's executive editor of previews and host of IGN's weekly Xbox show, Podcast Unlocked , and a co-host of Next-Gen Console Watch . He's a North Jersey guy, so it's "Taylor ham," not "pork roll." Debate it with him on Twitter at @DMC_Ryan .
paragraphs.cn: Ryan McCaffrey是IGN负责游戏前瞻的执行编辑、IGN每周XBOX节目《Podcast Unlocked》的主持人，也是《Next-Gen Console Watch》的联合主持人。他是新泽西州北部人，所以那叫「Taylor ham」，而不是「pork roll」。可以在X上通过@DMC_Ryan和他争论这个问题。
